messages.subject: rhwatch and 'map' output
parts:
Hi,

  I am new to HIPE and are working through exampels in http://ml.stat.purdue.edu/rhafen/rhipe/#mapfiles.  However, the examples in that post still uses rhmr.

   My question is mainly about how to use type other than sequence in rhwatch. For instance, the following code convert sequence files to map. How should I do it in rhwatch? I tried my own code as rhS2M_new below but it does not work (Error message: "java.io.FileNotFoundException: File does not exist: /user/huangd/rhipe/iris/bySpeciesSub_map/part-r-00000 ...."". 

    Thanks for your help in advance!

Dayu

Code in the blog:
rhS2M <- function(ifolder, ofolder, ...) {
   map <- expression({
     lapply(seq_along(map.values), function(i)
       rhcollect(map.keys[[i]], map.values[[i]]))
   })
   z <- rhmr(map=map, ifolder=ifolder, ofolder=ofolder, inout=c("sequence", "map"), ...)
   rhex(z)
}

rhS2M("/user/huangd/rhipe/iris/bySpeciesSub/", "/user/huangd/rhipe/iris/bySpeciesSub_map")
 
My code::


rhS2M_new <- function(ifolder, ofolder, ...) {
   map <- expression({
     lapply(seq_along(map.values), function(i)
       rhcollect(map.keys[[i]], map.values[[i]]))
   })
   z <- rhwatch(map=map, input=ifolder, output=rhfmt('map',folders=ofolder),
   ...)
}

rhS2M_new("/user/huangd/rhipe/iris/bySpeciesSub/", "/user/huangd/rhipe/iris/bySpeciesSub_map")
